ingress_subtitle: Applied instantly, no deploy: muelle creates the Cloudflare record and the Caddy route.
ingress_empty_title: This app has no domains yet
ingress_empty_body: Add one above: muelle creates the Cloudflare record and the Caddy route.
ingress_footnote: If the service doesn't exist yet, the route is created anyway and answers 502 until the first deploy.
ingress_dns_cloudflare_dual: A and AAAA records in Cloudflare
ingress_adopt_before: There's already a record with this name in Cloudflare (A, AAAA or CNAME) that muelle didn't create. Adopting it points it to
ingress_adopt_after: and lets muelle manage it, keeping its Proxied setting.
ingress_adopt_body_no_ip: There's already a record with this name in Cloudflare that muelle didn't create. To adopt it, muelle needs the server's public IP: set it in Settings.
ingress_manual_body: muelle doesn't manage this domain's DNS: there's no Cloudflare token, or the zone isn't in your account. Create this record at your DNS provider; muelle checks it every minute for the first 10 minutes:
ingress_error_fallback: muelle couldn't finish setting up the domain.
ingress_edit_body: Which service and port of the app gets the traffic.
ingress_remove_body: Removes the Caddy route and, if muelle created them, the Cloudflare records.
ingress_toast_added_body: The route is already in Caddy; the certificate takes a few seconds.
ingress_toast_adopted_body: muelle now manages the record for {hostname}.
ingress_error_taken: That hostname is already in use in muelle.
ingress_hostname_not_bare: No https:// or path: just the hostname.
ingress_hostname_bad_label: Only letters, numbers and hyphens, not at the start or end.
ingress_target_service: The service isn't a valid name.
ingress_error_cloudflare_unavailable: Cloudflare didn't respond or rejected the deletion, and nothing was deleted. Try again; to delete it only in muelle, remove the Cloudflare token in Settings.
ingress_error_docker: Docker is not responding on the muelle server.
ingress_proxy_out_of_sync_title: The proxy is out of sync.
ingress_proxy_out_of_sync_body: {error}. muelle retries on its own; until then domain changes may not show.
ingress_proxy_out_of_sync_generic: muelle couldn't apply the proxy configuration (Caddy didn't accept it, or the container couldn't be created). It retries on its own; until then domain changes may not show.
ingress_proxy_stopped_body: Domains get no traffic until it is back.
ingress_proxy_recreating_body: The muelle-caddy image or ports changed: it is back in a few seconds.
ingress_proxy_disabled_body: The panel domain or the Caddy image is missing: domains get no traffic.
ingress_toast_added_error: {hostname} was added, but with an error
ingress_toast_added_exists: {hostname} was added: the record already existed
ingress_toast_added_exists_body: There is a record with that name in Cloudflare that muelle did not create. Adopt it so muelle manages it.
ingress_toast_added_manual_body: Create the DNS record shown: muelle checks it every minute for 10 minutes, or press Verify.
ingress_toast_adopt_failed: Could not adopt the record for {hostname}
